sacred-vessel.name: Sacred Vessel
sacred-vessel.description: A peculiar relic from the tomb of Inaros.

sawgaw-echo-lure.name: Sawgaw Echo-Lure
sawgaw-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Sawgaw with life-like animal calls.

sawgaw-pheromone-synthesizer.name: Sawgaw Pheromone Synthesizer
sawgaw-pheromone-synthesizer.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Sawgaw.

scorpion-specter.name: Scorpion Specter
scorpion-specter.description: Deploys a SCORPION EXIMUS unit to fight for you.

sentry-gun.name: Sentry Gun
sentry-gun.description: Ordis delivers an automatic turret that will fire upon nearby visible enemies.

shield-osprey-specter.name: Shield Osprey Specter
shield-osprey-specter.description: Deploys a SHIELD OSPREY EXIMUS unit to fight for you.

shockprod-fishing-spear.name: Shockprod Fishing Spear
shockprod-fishing-spear.description:
Purpose built to recover Servofish without damage. Delivers a disabling electromagnetic pulse after a successful hit if timed correctly.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).

shotgun-ammo-box.name: Shotgun Ammo Box
shotgun-ammo-box.description: Restores a bunch of shotgun ammo.

sniper-ammo-box.name: Sniper Ammo Box
sniper-ammo-box.description: Restores a bunch of sniper ammo.

snow-globe.name: Snow Globe
snow-globe.description: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.

spari-spear.name: Spari Spear
spari-spear.description:
Plumb the depths with this crafty fishing spear that's barely detectable to Infested and hybrid/Orokin fish. Due to its Infested aspect, it's one of the only known things that can pass through exocrine. 

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk. This spear is most effective on fish found in the Cambion Drift (Deimos).

squad-ammo-restore-large.name: Squad Ammo Restore (Large)
squad-ammo-restore-large.description: Restores 3x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.

squad-ammo-restore-medium.name: Squad Ammo Restore (Medium)
squad-ammo-restore-medium.description: Restores 2x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.

squad-ammo-restore-small.name: Squad Ammo Restore (Small)
squad-ammo-restore-small.description: Restores 1x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.

squad-energy-restore-large.name: Squad Energy Restore (Large)
squad-energy-restore-large.description: Restores Energy to all squad members. Pulses 100 Energy every 7.5s for 30s.

squad-energy-restore-medium.name: Squad Energy Restore (Medium)
squad-energy-restore-medium.description: Restores Energy to all squad members. Pulses 50 Energy every 5s for 20s.

squad-energy-restore-small.name: Squad Energy Restore (Small)
squad-energy-restore-small.description: Restores Energy to all squad members. Pulses 25 Energy every 7.5s for 30s.

squad-health-restore-large.name: Squad Health Restore (Large)
squad-health-restore-large.description: Restores Health to all squad members. Pulses 300 Health every 7.5s for 30s.

squad-health-restore-medium.name: Squad Health Restore (Medium)
squad-health-restore-medium.description: Restores Health to all squad members. Pulses 100 Health every 5s for 20s.

squad-health-restore-small.name: Squad Health Restore (Small)
squad-health-restore-small.description: Restores Health to all squad members. Pulses 30 Health every 7.5s for 30s.

squad-shield-restore-large.name: Squad Shield Restore (Large)
squad-shield-restore-large.description: Restores Shields to all squad members. Pulses 300 Shield every 7.5s for 30s.

squad-shield-restore-medium.name: Squad Shield Restore (Medium)
squad-shield-restore-medium.description: Restores Shields to all squad members. Pulses 100 Shield every 7.5s for 30s.

squad-shield-restore-small.name: Squad Shield Restore (Small)
squad-shield-restore-small.description: Restores Shields to all squad members. Pulses 35 Shield every 7.5s for 30s.

stable-corruptor.name: Stable Corruptor
stable-corruptor.description: Injected into a Fomorian Reactor this corruptor will imbalance the fuels. Critically imbalanced reactors will eventually implode, destroy the ship. Slow but effective, recommended for Solo Tenno.

stalker-beacon.name: Stalker Beacon
stalker-beacon.description: Lures the Stalker out of hiding. One-time use gear item that can only be used in locations where the assassin would normally appear.

stalker-specter.name: Stalker Specter
stalker-specter.description: Deploys a clone of the Stalker to fight for you.

starburst.name: Starburst
starburst.description: Celebrate the holiday with fireworks! Light up the sky with this single use consumable item.

stover-echo-lure.name: Stover Echo-Lure
stover-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Stovers with life-like animal calls.

stover-pheromone-synthesizer.name: Stover Pheromone Synthesizer
stover-pheromone-synthesizer.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Stover.

stunna-fishing-spear.name: Stunna Fishing Spear
stunna-fishing-spear.description:
Successful electromagnetic pulses radiate outward also disabling any nearby Servofish.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).

sunpoint-plasma-drill.name: Sunpoint Plasma Drill
sunpoint-plasma-drill.description:
Fast-ignition, high-intensity mining tool capable of extracting the rarest of materials with surgical precision.

Can be used to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape. Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.

sunrise-apothic.name: Sunrise Apothic
sunrise-apothic.description: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.

surge-eximus-specter.name: Surge Eximus Specter
surge-eximus-specter.description: Deploys a clone of the Surge Eximus to fight for you.

synathid-bait.name: Synathid Bait
synathid-bait.description:
This bait is synthesized from specialized A-disulphex-A compounds that are known to attract Synathid, a legendarily rare Servofish found only in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

synthesis-scanner.name: Synthesis Scanner
synthesis-scanner.description: Synthesize a genetic data of the target and uploads it to the Sanctuary.
